title: Among female superheroes published by Marvel Comics, list those whose heigh
question: Among female superheroes published by Marvel Comics, list those whose height is greater than 70% of the average height of all superheroes. Return their full name and the number of superpowers they have.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_020" AS full_name,
    COUNT(hp."XCL_013") AS number_of_superpowers
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s."XCL_021" = g."XCL_007"
JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s."XCL_018" = hp."XCL_012"
WHERE g."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s."XCL_028" > 0.7 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
GROUP BY s."XCL_018", s."XCL_020"
